table.description: ServiceNow table, picked by the record number prefix: INC incident, CHG change_request, PRB problem, REQ sc_request (request), RITM sc_req_item (requested item), SCTASK sc_task (catalog task).

record_id.description: Optional. For change_request, the change sys_id or number (for example CHG0030002) to list the states that change can move to next. Other tables always return all state choices.

field.description: Optional. A choice field of the table to list the valid values of instead of the states, for example close_code (the resolution code needed to resolve an incident), request_state for a request or stage for a requested item. Values differ per instance, so read them here instead of guessing.
